## Step 2: Plan a supervised workflow

### 📖 Theory: separate recommendations from mutations

A supervised plan can gather and summarize context automatically while reserving labels, assignments, closures, and publication for a human reviewer.

### ⌨️ Activity: plan the workflow

1. In Plan Mode, design a daily review of newly opened issues in this repository.
2. Require a summary, priority and topic-label recommendations, and rationale.
3. Treat Microsoft 365 context as read-only input. Prohibit automatic labeling, closing, assignment, and publication of Work IQ source content.
4. Post the approved summary here.

```text
<!-- step-2-plan:start -->

Scope: <which issues the workflow reviews>
Outputs: <the recommendation fields it produces>

<!-- step-2-plan:end -->
```
